correctness.rationale: The original algebra has genuine automorphisms phi(t)=ut+vt^2+wt^3, u!=0; therefore phi(t^2)=u^2t^2+2uvt^3 and phi(t^3)=u^3t^3. The local orbit equations split into x_1!=0 (solve v,w), x_1=0,x_2!=0 (force c square and, in characteristic 2, e=0 and f=u^3), and x_1=x_2=0 (force f cube). This proves necessary/sufficient lower-triangular forms for arbitrary fields, including imperfect ones; in odd finite q the diagonal square/cube image sizes give q^3(q-1)^3/(2 gcd(3,q-1)), and in even q they give q^2(q-1)^2. A nontrivial local but nongenuine example exists outside F_2. Direct orbit-definition enumeration for F_2 and F_3 and inspected independent F_4/F_5 checker support boundary groups; arbitrary-field proof does not depend on finite enumeration.
